label: M-06
title: Post-conditions confirm the stablecoin LEFT, never that the yield strategy CREDITED it; on a current-master strategy the stable leg is minted against principal that was not fully credited
fingerprintNote: sha256(contract:function:rootCauseClass)[:16] - legacy form, empty entryPoint. Carried verbatim from sanitized.json; reproduces from fingerprintBasis.

classification.assetImpact: IF the claim holds against the deployed code: the stable leg's phUSD is sized from `amount`, never from what the yield strategy actually credited, so phUSD would be issued against principal that was not fully credited - an unquantified backing shortfall. Size UNKNOWN and unmeasured.
attackPath: (NOT DEMONSTRATED - diff-only reasoning; the DEPLOYED yield-strategy/vault version is unknown because the nested vault pin 043ff2c is 11 commits behind vault master 0110ce4.)
1. PhusdStableMinter makes a bare statement call to IYieldStrategy.deposit and discards its return value.
2. Antimatter's post-conditions cannot catch a shortfall: :230 asserts only that the stablecoin LEFT Antimatter, and :232-233 measure a phUSD delta and require it merely to be NON-ZERO.
3. On a current-master strategy that credits less than the deposited principal, the difference is unbacked. Whether any DEPLOYED strategy behaves this way is UNVERIFIED.
classification.likelihood: UNKNOWN. Not established against any deployed contract.
classification.assumptions: That the DEPLOYED yield strategy is a vault-master-tree build (0110ce4-era, deposit() returning creditedPrincipal) rather than a 043ff2c-era build. If the deployed strategy is the 043ff2c-era build there is NO finding at all. Note this is a question about the deployed STRATEGY/VAULT version, not about the minter, whose pin is current.
classification.externalRequirements: A yield strategy whose deposit credits less than the principal transferred.

justification: CLASSIFIED BUT PARKED, per instruction, and the label must not be read as a verdict. The Medium label is carried forward from the highest input severity (ECON-004 medium over CODE-006 low, per the conflicting-severity rule) as a PLACEHOLDER for triage ordering only. This finding is diff-only: the minter pin is CURRENT (d6ed1156 == remote master tip), but the nested vault pin (043ff2c) is 11 commits behind vault master (0110ce4), so the DEPLOYED yield-strategy/vault version is unknown - and the standing 'nested submodule pin stale trap' rule says cross-repo claims must be read from the deployed/top-level sibling checkout, because nested lib/mutable/** is stale by construction. It is therefore not adjudicable in this run and MUST NOT be submitted, PoC'd as fact, or cited as a known shortfall until the manual-review action is completed. It is kept in a visible channel rather than dropped (Law 1: recall beats report-tidiness). NOTE the recommendation that survives independently of the parked claim and can be actioned now: replace the unbounded `mintedForStable == 0` check at :233 with a two-sided assertion against minter.calculateMintAmount(stable, stableAmount). That same mitigation is shared with L-01 and F-01, which are NOT parked.
recommendation: Independently of the above: replace the unbounded `mintedForStable == 0` check at :233 with a two-sided assertion against minter.calculateMintAmount(stable, stableAmount), so a short or unexpected mint reverts rather than silently shortchanging the annihilator.

sanitizer.reason: No known-issues document exists for this project (knownIssuesFile/Source null, knownIssues empty, verified at HEAD) so KI suppression has no authority; no C4 known-invalid class genuinely applies; not a malicious-owner vector; ledger empty so no prior entry to reconcile against.

additionalContext.parkedReason: PARKED VISIBLY, NOT DROPPED (Law 1: recall beats tidiness). PARK RATIONALE CORRECTED 2026-08-18 (review pass) - the original rationale was FACTUALLY WRONG and is superseded. It is NOT true that the phUSD-stable-minter pin is stale: antimatter pins lib/phUSD-stable-minter at d6ed1156, which IS the minter's remote master tip, so THE MINTER PIN IS CURRENT. The stale layer is one level deeper: lib/phUSD-stable-minter/lib/vault is pinned at 043ff2c while vault's remote master is 0110ce4 - 11 commits ahead, including stories 043/044/048/049, which are precisely the commits that introduced deposit() returning creditedPrincipal. What cannot be adjudicated at this commit is therefore WHICH YIELD-STRATEGY / VAULT VERSION IS ACTUALLY DEPLOYED, because this finding depends entirely on the deployed strategy's deposit() return behaviour - not on the minter's version.
additionalContext.rootCause: The stable leg's phUSD is sized from `amount`, never from what the yield strategy actually credited. PhusdStableMinter makes a bare statement call to IYieldStrategy.deposit and discards its return. Antimatter's post-conditions cannot catch a shortfall: :230 asserts only that the stablecoin LEFT Antimatter, :232-233 measures a phUSD delta and requires it merely to be non-zero.

diffEvidence.pinnedTree: lib/phUSD-stable-minter/lib/vault @ 043ff2c - IYieldStrategy.sol:15 declares deposit(address,uint256,address) with NO return. Against this tree the discard is correct and there is no finding.
diffEvidence.masterTree: vault master 0110ce4 - IYieldStrategy.sol:24 declares `... returns (uint256 creditedPrincipal)`, introduced by stories 043/044/048/049 precisely because conservative ERC4626 crediting can credit strictly LESS than `amount`.
diffEvidence.abiImpact: NONE - the selector depends on argument types only and Solidity ignores surplus returndata, so a master-tree strategy does not brick the call; it silently succeeds while the shortfall goes unrecorded. That silence is what makes this worth filing.
diffEvidence.pinProvenance: antimatter -> lib/phUSD-stable-minter @ d6ed1156 = minter remote master tip (CURRENT). lib/phUSD-stable-minter -> lib/vault @ 043ff2c vs vault remote master 0110ce4 (11 commits behind, STALE). The staleness is in the vault/strategy layer only.

additionalContext.impactIfItHolds: The 'backed' leg is itself partially unbacked, compounding with DEDUP-004's structurally unbacked leg. Silent by construction: no event, no revert, no view records the difference between phUSD issued for the stable leg and principal credited for it. Applies to every deposit through the minter, not just annihilations.
additionalContext.manualReviewAction: RE-CHECK INSTRUCTION (corrected): read the DEPLOYED yield strategy - resolved from chain for the stablecoins actually registered - and measure creditedPrincipal versus amount there. DO NOT re-check the phUSD-stable-minter pin: it is already current (d6ed1156 == remote master tip) and re-checking it would wrongly conclude that this park is resolved. The open question is the deployed strategy/vault version, not the minter's. If the deployed strategy's deposit() returns no value or credits the full principal (043ff2c-era behaviour), close as not-applicable. If it credits less than the principal transferred, size the stable leg from the returned value (minter-side fix) and/or have Antimatter assert mintedForStable is within tolerance of minter.calculateMintAmount(stable, stableAmount).
additionalContext.sharedMitigationNote: One edit at :233 (assert against calculateMintAmount) closes all three, but the three are NOT collapsed: they are distinct root causes (upstream under-credit / in-window inbound sweep / no caller-side expectation guard) with distinct preconditions and distinct evidence.
